captureSource.description: Hosted IceGraph demo with mock data, deployed from v0.25.3

artifacts.alt: IceGraph Timeline listing Iceberg table events with row counts, branch lanes, and an open details panel

artifacts.route: /table/graph opened from the selected Timeline event's View in graph: Snapshot button
artifacts.alt: IceGraph Graph tracing one snapshot from its metadata files through manifests to data files, with a red link marking a deleted file entry
IceGraph Metadata view showing the table schema, partitioning, and write sort order

artifacts.route: /table/filetree?table=default.events (Expand all, partition event_ts_hour = 2025-06-15 11:00 UTC selected, inspector widened and scrolled to the column metrics)
artifacts.alt: IceGraph File Tree with a partition selected and its statistics panel showing file sizes, row and delete counts, and per-column metrics
IceGraph Partition Files view showing the latest snapshot, its manifests, and the data files of one partition
IceGraph Ask AI window open over the Timeline, with suggested questions and context chips for choosing which table metadata to send

artifacts.route: /table/timeline?table=default.events, select Data overwritten, View in graph: Snapshot
artifacts.alt: Short IceGraph walkthrough selecting an Iceberg table event in Timeline and continuing into Graph for detailed investigation

capture.method: Playwright JPEG screenshots (quality 95) sampled near 12 fps, drawn to a 1920 by 1200 canvas and encoded with Chromium MediaRecorder (video/mp4;codecs=avc1.42E01E). Graph loading frames are cut so the video moves from the selected Timeline event straight to the settled Graph.
